title: Bashar :: The Silent Season - Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: Bashar introduces "the silent season," describing a transitional passage between cycles as humanity moves toward 2026 and disclosure. He explains that this transmission offers a specialized meditation and exercise designed to align all necessary elements for accelerating open contact and disclosure. The practice is positioned as part of the Interstellar Alliance's social experiment, intended to help crystallize the conditions needed for contact to manifest most efficiently and beneficially for all.

qa_topics.question: How can I better understand my spirit team communications and light language?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Light language is raw channeled energy not yet translated into earthly language. Practice grounding it through people asking questions, or use journaling for 15-20 minutes daily to train your brain to translate it into physical language over 2-3 weeks.

qa_topics.question: Is it part of my soul contract that I cannot see my spirit guides visually?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Your soul contract does not forbid visual perception of guides. You can improve this ability through consistent practice and intention without changing your fundamental soul contract.

key_terms.term: passage from one cycle to another

quotes.quote: Now you are going through a passage from one cycle to another...enter 2026, the year of disclosure.
You can provide the organized energy that will allow that reality to crystallize.
Light language is simply the receiving of channeled energy not being translated into language you understand.
No, you cannot change your soul contract, but I'm not saying that is part of your soul contract.
Do this for two to three weeks. You will start seeing patterns.
This exercise is part of the Interstellar Alliance social experiment.

predictions_and_dates.context: Year of disclosure; humanity transitioning toward open contact

tools_or_exercises: Specialized meditation for alignment during the silent season
Journaling practice (15-20 minutes daily for 2-3 weeks) to translate light language
Grounding channeled information through question-based dialogue
